Class ScenarioSetupPanel

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane

org.ether.society.ui.ScenarioSetupPanel
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class ScenarioSetupPanel extends javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
Unified Panel for setting up a simulation. Combines Scenario parameters, World Generation (Procedural/Real/Load), and Preview.
